title: Dota2Pred — Paper Betting: Confidence Explorer
description: Counterfactual replay of the paper-betting rules at a selectable min_confidence floor. Recomputes evaluate_bet (liquidity >= 500, spread <= 0.06, per-side max edge among sides with model_p >= floor, tau = 0.03, quarter-Kelly compounding) live from match_odds_snapshots + match_predictions + match_outcomes. The stored match_paper_bets table (the scheduled replay's official record) is not touched or read here.

list.name: min_confidence
list.label: Min model confidence
list.description: Only bet a side whose model probability is at least this. 0.0 = current scheduled rules (bet on edge alone).

targets.rawSql: WITH snaps AS (SELECT s.match_id, s.captured_at, p.prediction_probability AS p_rad, o.radiant_win, s.a_best_bid, s.a_best_ask, s.a_liquidity, s.b_best_bid, s.b_best_ask, s.b_liquidity FROM match_odds_snapshots s JOIN match_predictions p ON p.match_id = s.match_id AND p.predictor_name = 'logistic_regression_pro_matches' LEFT JOIN match_outcomes o ON o.match_id = s.match_id WHERE s.snapshot_kind = 'entry' AND s.a_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND s.b_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND p.prediction_probability IS NOT NULL), sides AS (SELECT sn.match_id, sn.captured_at, sn.radiant_win, v.side, v.q, v.ask FROM snaps sn CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('radiant', sn.p_rad, sn.a_best_ask, sn.a_best_bid, sn.a_liquidity), ('dire', 1.0 - sn.p_rad, sn.b_best_ask, sn.b_best_bid, sn.b_liquidity)) AS v(side, q, ask, bid, liq) WHERE v.ask IS NOT NULL AND v.bid IS NOT NULL AND (v.liq IS NULL OR v.liq >= 500.0) AND (v.ask - v.bid) <= 0.06 AND v.q >= ${min_confidence}::float), best AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (match_id) match_id, captured_at, radiant_win, side, q, ask, q - ask AS edge FROM sides ORDER BY match_id, (q - ask) DESC), bets AS (SELECT b.*, (b.radiant_win = (b.side = 'radiant')) AS won, 0.25 * (b.q - b.ask) / (1.0 - b.ask) AS frac FROM best b WHERE b.edge > 0.03) SELECT count(*) AS bets FROM bets WHERE won IS NOT NULL

WITH snaps AS (SELECT s.match_id, s.captured_at, p.prediction_probability AS p_rad, o.radiant_win, s.a_best_bid, s.a_best_ask, s.a_liquidity, s.b_best_bid, s.b_best_ask, s.b_liquidity FROM match_odds_snapshots s JOIN match_predictions p ON p.match_id = s.match_id AND p.predictor_name = 'logistic_regression_pro_matches' LEFT JOIN match_outcomes o ON o.match_id = s.match_id WHERE s.snapshot_kind = 'entry' AND s.a_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND s.b_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND p.prediction_probability IS NOT NULL), sides AS (SELECT sn.match_id, sn.captured_at, sn.radiant_win, v.side, v.q, v.ask FROM snaps sn CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('radiant', sn.p_rad, sn.a_best_ask, sn.a_best_bid, sn.a_liquidity), ('dire', 1.0 - sn.p_rad, sn.b_best_ask, sn.b_best_bid, sn.b_liquidity)) AS v(side, q, ask, bid, liq) WHERE v.ask IS NOT NULL AND v.bid IS NOT NULL AND (v.liq IS NULL OR v.liq >= 500.0) AND (v.ask - v.bid) <= 0.06 AND v.q >= ${min_confidence}::float), best AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (match_id) match_id, captured_at, radiant_win, side, q, ask, q - ask AS edge FROM sides ORDER BY match_id, (q - ask) DESC), bets AS (SELECT b.*, (b.radiant_win = (b.side = 'radiant')) AS won FROM best b WHERE b.edge > 0.03) SELECT avg(won::int) AS hit_rate FROM bets WHERE won IS NOT NULL

WITH snaps AS (SELECT s.match_id, s.captured_at, p.prediction_probability AS p_rad, o.radiant_win, s.a_best_bid, s.a_best_ask, s.a_liquidity, s.b_best_bid, s.b_best_ask, s.b_liquidity FROM match_odds_snapshots s JOIN match_predictions p ON p.match_id = s.match_id AND p.predictor_name = 'logistic_regression_pro_matches' LEFT JOIN match_outcomes o ON o.match_id = s.match_id WHERE s.snapshot_kind = 'entry' AND s.a_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND s.b_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND p.prediction_probability IS NOT NULL), sides AS (SELECT sn.match_id, sn.captured_at, sn.radiant_win, v.side, v.q, v.ask FROM snaps sn CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('radiant', sn.p_rad, sn.a_best_ask, sn.a_best_bid, sn.a_liquidity), ('dire', 1.0 - sn.p_rad, sn.b_best_ask, sn.b_best_bid, sn.b_liquidity)) AS v(side, q, ask, bid, liq) WHERE v.ask IS NOT NULL AND v.bid IS NOT NULL AND (v.liq IS NULL OR v.liq >= 500.0) AND (v.ask - v.bid) <= 0.06 AND v.q >= ${min_confidence}::float), best AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (match_id) match_id, captured_at, radiant_win, side, q, ask, q - ask AS edge FROM sides ORDER BY match_id, (q - ask) DESC), bets AS (SELECT b.*, (b.radiant_win = (b.side = 'radiant')) AS won, 0.25 * (b.q - b.ask) / (1.0 - b.ask) AS frac FROM best b WHERE b.edge > 0.03), curve AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN won THEN 1.0 + frac * (1.0 - ask) / ask ELSE 1.0 - frac END AS mult FROM bets WHERE won IS NOT NULL) SELECT coalesce(1000.0 * exp(sum(ln(mult))) - 1000.0, 0.0) AS kelly_pnl FROM curve

WITH snaps AS (SELECT s.match_id, s.captured_at, p.prediction_probability AS p_rad, o.radiant_win, s.a_best_bid, s.a_best_ask, s.a_liquidity, s.b_best_bid, s.b_best_ask, s.b_liquidity FROM match_odds_snapshots s JOIN match_predictions p ON p.match_id = s.match_id AND p.predictor_name = 'logistic_regression_pro_matches' LEFT JOIN match_outcomes o ON o.match_id = s.match_id WHERE s.snapshot_kind = 'entry' AND s.a_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND s.b_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND p.prediction_probability IS NOT NULL), sides AS (SELECT sn.match_id, sn.captured_at, sn.radiant_win, v.side, v.q, v.ask FROM snaps sn CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('radiant', sn.p_rad, sn.a_best_ask, sn.a_best_bid, sn.a_liquidity), ('dire', 1.0 - sn.p_rad, sn.b_best_ask, sn.b_best_bid, sn.b_liquidity)) AS v(side, q, ask, bid, liq) WHERE v.ask IS NOT NULL AND v.bid IS NOT NULL AND (v.liq IS NULL OR v.liq >= 500.0) AND (v.ask - v.bid) <= 0.06 AND v.q >= ${min_confidence}::float), best AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (match_id) match_id, captured_at, radiant_win, side, q, ask, q - ask AS edge FROM sides ORDER BY match_id, (q - ask) DESC), bets AS (SELECT b.*, (b.radiant_win = (b.side = 'radiant')) AS won FROM best b WHERE b.edge > 0.03) SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN won THEN (10.0 / ask) * (1.0 - ask) ELSE -10.0 END), 0.0) AS flat_pnl FROM bets WHERE won IS NOT NULL

WITH snaps AS (SELECT s.match_id, s.captured_at, p.prediction_probability AS p_rad, o.radiant_win, s.a_best_bid, s.a_best_ask, s.a_liquidity, s.b_best_bid, s.b_best_ask, s.b_liquidity FROM match_odds_snapshots s JOIN match_predictions p ON p.match_id = s.match_id AND p.predictor_name = 'logistic_regression_pro_matches' LEFT JOIN match_outcomes o ON o.match_id = s.match_id WHERE s.snapshot_kind = 'entry' AND s.a_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND s.b_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND p.prediction_probability IS NOT NULL), sides AS (SELECT sn.match_id, sn.captured_at, sn.radiant_win, v.side, v.q, v.ask FROM snaps sn CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('radiant', sn.p_rad, sn.a_best_ask, sn.a_best_bid, sn.a_liquidity), ('dire', 1.0 - sn.p_rad, sn.b_best_ask, sn.b_best_bid, sn.b_liquidity)) AS v(side, q, ask, bid, liq) WHERE v.ask IS NOT NULL AND v.bid IS NOT NULL AND (v.liq IS NULL OR v.liq >= 500.0) AND (v.ask - v.bid) <= 0.06 AND v.q >= ${min_confidence}::float), best AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (match_id) match_id, captured_at, radiant_win, side, q, ask, q - ask AS edge FROM sides ORDER BY match_id, (q - ask) DESC), bets AS (SELECT b.*, (b.radiant_win = (b.side = 'radiant')) AS won FROM best b WHERE b.edge > 0.03) SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN won THEN (10.0 / ask) * (1.0 - ask) ELSE -10.0 END) / nullif(10.0 * count(*), 0), 0.0) AS roi FROM bets WHERE won IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Bankroll at min_confidence = $min_confidence: Kelly (compounded) vs flat baseline
panels.description: Both series start at $1,000. Bet order = snapshot capture order. Selection rule replayed with the chosen confidence floor; sizing rule unchanged (quarter-Kelly of the model's stated edge).

targets.rawSql: WITH snaps AS (SELECT s.match_id, s.captured_at, p.prediction_probability AS p_rad, o.radiant_win, s.a_best_bid, s.a_best_ask, s.a_liquidity, s.b_best_bid, s.b_best_ask, s.b_liquidity FROM match_odds_snapshots s JOIN match_predictions p ON p.match_id = s.match_id AND p.predictor_name = 'logistic_regression_pro_matches' LEFT JOIN match_outcomes o ON o.match_id = s.match_id WHERE s.snapshot_kind = 'entry' AND s.a_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND s.b_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND p.prediction_probability IS NOT NULL), sides AS (SELECT sn.match_id, sn.captured_at, sn.radiant_win, v.side, v.q, v.ask FROM snaps sn CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('radiant', sn.p_rad, sn.a_best_ask, sn.a_best_bid, sn.a_liquidity), ('dire', 1.0 - sn.p_rad, sn.b_best_ask, sn.b_best_bid, sn.b_liquidity)) AS v(side, q, ask, bid, liq) WHERE v.ask IS NOT NULL AND v.bid IS NOT NULL AND (v.liq IS NULL OR v.liq >= 500.0) AND (v.ask - v.bid) <= 0.06 AND v.q >= ${min_confidence}::float), best AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (match_id) match_id, captured_at, radiant_win, side, q, ask, q - ask AS edge FROM sides ORDER BY match_id, (q - ask) DESC), bets AS (SELECT b.*, (b.radiant_win = (b.side = 'radiant')) AS won, 0.25 * (b.q - b.ask) / (1.0 - b.ask) AS frac FROM best b WHERE b.edge > 0.03), curve AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN won THEN 1.0 + frac * (1.0 - ask) / ask ELSE 1.0 - frac END AS mult, CASE WHEN won THEN (10.0 / ask) * (1.0 - ask) ELSE -10.0 END AS flat_pnl FROM bets WHERE won IS NOT NULL) SELECT captured_at AS "time", 1000.0 * exp(sum(ln(mult)) OVER w) AS "Kelly bankroll", 1000.0 + sum(flat_pnl) OVER w AS "Flat baseline" FROM curve WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY captured_at ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) ORDER BY captured_at

panels.title: All thresholds at a glance (same data, same rules)
panels.description: One row per candidate confidence floor, so the selected value can be judged in context. Small samples at high floors — treat with caution.

targets.rawSql: WITH snaps AS (SELECT s.match_id, s.captured_at, p.prediction_probability AS p_rad, o.radiant_win, s.a_best_bid, s.a_best_ask, s.a_liquidity, s.b_best_bid, s.b_best_ask, s.b_liquidity FROM match_odds_snapshots s JOIN match_predictions p ON p.match_id = s.match_id AND p.predictor_name = 'logistic_regression_pro_matches' LEFT JOIN match_outcomes o ON o.match_id = s.match_id WHERE s.snapshot_kind = 'entry' AND s.a_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND s.b_best_ask IS NOT NULL AND p.prediction_probability IS NOT NULL), th AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[0.0, 0.50, 0.55, 0.60, 0.65]) AS threshold), sides AS (SELECT th.threshold, sn.match_id, sn.captured_at, sn.radiant_win, v.side, v.q, v.ask FROM snaps sn CROSS JOIN th CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('radiant', sn.p_rad, sn.a_best_ask, sn.a_best_bid, sn.a_liquidity), ('dire', 1.0 - sn.p_rad, sn.b_best_ask, sn.b_best_bid, sn.b_liquidity)) AS v(side, q, ask, bid, liq) WHERE v.ask IS NOT NULL AND v.bid IS NOT NULL AND (v.liq IS NULL OR v.liq >= 500.0) AND (v.ask - v.bid) <= 0.06 AND v.q >= th.threshold), best AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (threshold, match_id) threshold, match_id, radiant_win, side, q, ask, q - ask AS edge FROM sides ORDER BY threshold, match_id, (q - ask) DESC), bets AS (SELECT b.*, (b.radiant_win = (b.side = 'radiant')) AS won, 0.25 * (b.q - b.ask) / (1.0 - b.ask) AS frac FROM best b WHERE b.edge > 0.03) SELECT threshold, count(*) AS bets, avg(won::int) AS hit_rate, 1000.0 * exp(sum(ln(CASE WHEN won THEN 1.0 + frac * (1.0 - ask) / ask ELSE 1.0 - frac END))) - 1000.0 AS kelly_pnl, sum(CASE WHEN won THEN (10.0 / ask) * (1.0 - ask) ELSE -10.0 END) AS flat_pnl FROM bets WHERE won IS NOT NULL GROUP BY threshold ORDER BY threshold

panels.title: Bets under selected threshold
panels.description: The counterfactual bet list at the chosen confidence floor. flat_pnl is per-bet ($10 flat stake); Kelly per-bet PnL is path-dependent and shown only in the bankroll chart.
